stem:
$\mathbf{D}$, $\mathbf{E}$, $\mathbf{F}$, and $\mathbf{G}$ are four consecutive elements in the **fourth** period of the Periodic Table. (The letters are **not** the actual symbols of the elements.)

$\mathbf{D}$ is a soft, silvery metal with a melting point just above room temperature. Its amphoteric oxide, $\mathbf{D}_2\text{O}_3$, has a melting point of $1900^{\circ}\text{C}$ and can be formed by heating $\mathbf{D}$ in oxygen.

$\mathbf{G}$ is a solid that can exist as several different allotropes, most of which contain $\mathbf{G}_8$ molecules. $\mathbf{G}$ burns in air to form $\mathbf{G}\text{O}_2$ which dissolves in water to form an acidic solution. This solution reacts with sodium hydroxide to form the salt $\text{Na}_2\mathbf{G}\text{O}_3$.
